reviewScope: preview-product-boundary-successor.v3 only. This review does not mark DR-117 SATISFIED, open D-056 Class A, apply or seal the candidate, mint a D-096 grant, invent the DR-131 pack, authorize docs/v2/implementation/, or edit file 02, file 08, COORD, the subject, or the other review target.
summary: REJECT at 1 blocker and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Custody, exact seven-item carriage, lineage, the explicit P-1/P-2/G3 mapping, the P-2 findings-versus-host-authority split, the item-7 decomposition, and all non-application/non-SATISFIED prohibitions survive. CLAUDE-PPBS-V2-SF1 and CLAUDE-PPBS-V2-ADV-1 are repaired. PPBSV2-B1 is not fully repaired: EE-5b and EE-6b turn a request-admission rule into runtime confinement that the recorded architecture expressly says does not exist, and EE-7a/EE-7b retain partial owner/gate overclaims. Most decisively, EE-6b says the host refuses or fails closed when a trusted analyzer directly opens an undeclared socket, while D-032 assigns component-originated egress to DR-105 and D-128's dual-accepted permission-truth-tables.v9 says that direct denied egress under ambient authority succeeds, is neither observed nor recorded by the host, and is DISCLOSURE-ONLY. Suppressing an authoritative Run after an irreversible egress would not prove that no undeclared egress occurred, and the host has no stated observation mechanism with which to do even that. The enforcement-evidence limb is therefore false, not merely unexecuted. DR-117 remains OPEN and this verdict authorizes nothing.

blockers.title: The candidate mistakes request admission for runtime confinement and therefore specifies an impossible egress pass property
blockers.measurement: EE-6b's input is a first-party trusted analyzer that directly opens an undeclared socket during analyze without a network-granted PlanIntent. Its invariant is 'No undeclared analyze egress'; its pass result is 'Host refuses / fails closed'; its owner is this candidate; and its existing gate is none. Those bytes conflict with the adopted actor boundary and the current recorded DR-105 successor candidate. D-032 says that component CA-4 egress remains in DR-105. D-128 records permission-truth-tables.v9 at sha256 05d55964... after dual independent ACCEPT. That artifact defines PT-NET-EGRESS as component-originated egress, marks the child-process network cell DISCLOSURE-ONLY, states that the component may perform the effect directly under ambient authority and the host will neither observe nor record it, and requires fixture FX-2B to assert that denied direct egress connects successfully. Its central honesty rule says a brokered denial is a refused ASK, not a blocked ACT. EE-6b supplies no new confinement or exclusive mediation mechanism and expressly leaves demonstrated OS/WASM confinement at DR-128, yet requires the opposite result. 'No coherent Run' cannot retract bytes that already left, and the recorded model says the host cannot observe the direct action from which it would derive the claimed refusal. EE-5b repeats the category error: its input says the component executes an imperative action, but its pass says that an action first observed at execution is rejected before any stage. The cited v1-slice section 7 item 8 covers an excluded PlanIntent or a substitution detected after admission but before stage execution; it does not make an ambient action inside a running trusted component observable before it occurs. Item 7 is now split, but the exact evidence map is still not closed: EE-7a assigns the aggregate default-useful-install TypeScript-closure limb to DR-101 even though the D-114-recorded DR-101 contract owns signed-distribution-core/default-core inventory and expressly excludes analyzer components from that core closure; EE-7b calls DR-G13 a second-role refusal gate even though the live gate is the future per-supported-role language-quality corpus, while the sole TypeScript role list is the D-002/DR-118 design decision. These latter mappings reinforce the same unresolved ownership defect; EE-6b alone is dispositive.
blockers.governingConflict: DR-117's live acceptance cell is 'Explicit successor to P-1/P-2/G3 with enforcement evidence'. File 03's preserved confinement rule says host brokers voluntarily used by an unconstrained same-user process do not create confinement. File 02 says an unconstrained same-user component remains trusted code in the security TCB unless effective confinement is enforced and measured. D-032 places component-originated egress at DR-105, and D-128's recorded candidate makes the absence of enforcement a falsifiable, required result. A DR-117 candidate cannot answer the enforcement-evidence limb by silently assigning that property to itself and asserting the inverse outcome. Doing so would overturn the actor/confinement model without naming or measuring a mechanism, despite the subject's own statement that DR-128 remains post-MVP and its evidence is unexecuted.
counterexamples: Run the D-128 FX-2B shape with the first-party analyzer from EE-6b: deny or omit PT-NET-EGRESS, then let the child connect directly with ambient authority. The recorded passing result is that the connection succeeds and the host journal records nothing. EE-6b requires host refusal/fail-closed and no undeclared egress. Both cannot pass on the same preview architecture.

Let a trusted analyzer send bytes directly, then return malformed or partial protocol output. The host may reject the output as a Run, but the irreversible network effect already occurred. A typed non-success is fault/result integrity, not evidence for the invariant 'No undeclared analyze egress'.

Let an admitted first-party component begin a stage and perform an imperative ambient action not represented in its manifest or PlanIntent. If the action is only observed at execution, it cannot be rejected before that stage executes; v1-slice section 7 item 8 applies only to an excluded request form or a substitution caught before stage execution.

Admit a second preview language role while keeping every supported role's G13 quality corpus green. The quality gate can pass; the product role-list decision is what was violated. EE-7b's cited gate is not the discriminating refusal evidence.
blockers.whyBlocker: The false class is the enforcement half of the sole live DR-117 acceptance cell, not a peripheral implementation detail. A negative class whose required pass result contradicts the architecture's recorded execution and fixture result cannot make later execution mechanical. Accepting it would certify PPBSV2-B1 as repaired while the candidate still has no lawful owner or mechanism for direct analyze egress and represents DISCLOSURE-ONLY trusted execution as fail-closed enforcement.
blockers.requiredRepair: Retain the repaired lineage, P-1/P-2/G3 map, P-2 split, and item-7 decomposition. Rewrite EE-5b and EE-6b so declaration/admission refusal is not represented as confinement of actions inside a running trusted component. For network: keep PlanIntent/network-grant exclusion as the admission class; map component-originated PT-NET-EGRESS and its honest DISCLOSURE-ONLY result to DR-105/D-128/DR-G09; and either narrow the direct-egress class to an externally observable first-party release/qualification test that does not claim host prevention, or leave actual prevention to a named future confinement owner and do not claim CELL-2 answered by it. A rejected Run may be a separate result-integrity assertion but cannot stand in for preventing irreversible egress. For generic imperative behavior, define a constructible request/protocol substitution that is detected before execution, or acknowledge that arbitrary ambient runtime acts are trusted-TCB behavior rather than admission-enforced exclusions. Correct EE-7a's owner to distinguish core inventory from the aggregate useful-install selection, and distinguish D-002/DR-118's role-list decision from DR-G13's quality evidence. Keep every class unexecuted/not QUALIFIED, do not mark DR-117 SATISFIED, and authorize no implementation.

v2FindingAudit.detail: p1p2g3Mapping explicitly says P-1 is preserved by items 1/2, P-2 by items 3/5, and G3 is partially replaced by item 7 with the Rust sidecar deferred rather than abandoned. The mapping is no longer left to inference.
The lineage now distinguishes D-068 as the owner recording from product-boundary-preview.v2 as the effective disposition it records.

The conditional owner phrases, DR-G01..G05 egress assignment, unsplit item 7, and wholesale P-2-to-DR-133 assignment are repaired. The replacement evidence map nevertheless asserts impossible runtime refusal in EE-5b/EE-6b and retains partial owner/gate overclaims at EE-7a/EE-7b. See PPBSV3-B1.

sevenItemAudit.detail: Marketplace/catalog/governance is denied and unapproved-publisher admission has a constructible request-validation refusal class.
External discovery/public lifecycle is denied with an excluded-request refusal class.
EE-3a confines DR-133/D-136 to findings/provider output, while EE-3b separately keeps policy, persistence, rendering, termination, and lifecycle host-owned.
Untrusted native/WASM admission is an excluded request; demonstrated confinement remains DR-128 post-MVP; DR-G21 is not called a sandbox.

The host-doctor distinction and named manifest-role refusal are repaired. EE-5b still says an ambient imperative act first observed at execution is rejected before any stage, a temporal and trust-boundary contradiction covered by PPBSV3-B1.

EE-6a correctly refuses network-granted analysis requests and no longer cites DR-G01..G05. EE-6b falsely requires host refusal of direct ambient component egress despite D-032/D-128's DISCLOSURE-ONLY model.

The five sub-limbs are now separated and EE-7c/EE-7e correctly map runtime closure and anti-lockstep to DR-G14 and DR-G16. EE-7a overextends DR-101 from distribution-core inventory to the aggregate selected-TypeScript useful install, and EE-7b treats the G13 quality matrix as a second-role refusal gate.
